title: Priority Strata: Deployment-regime-aware Roadmap Scorer
creator: Lena Chen
description: We need a repeatable, deployment-aware prioritization scorer that augments traditional RICE with deployment-regime constraints. Motivation: features have different economics and risk depending on whether they target Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, or Private (VPC/on-prem). Current RICE-style scoring in PM decks ignores variance in unit cost, rollout complexity, and SLO surface per deployment mode, which leads to mis-prioritization of infra-sensitive work (autoscaler tuning, KV-cache improvements, region routing). This ticket defines the PRD for the Priority Strata Scorer: a prioritized decision surface that combines Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort with Deployment Strata modifiers (cost delta, latency SLO hit risk, rollout complexity, regulatory scope). The scorer should be transparent (spreadsheet), instrumentable (SQL/BI queries), and integrated with quarterly roadmap decisions and initiative OKRs.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc (Google Drive) describing formula and strata modifiers with example scoring for 12 canonical initiatives
Prototype spreadsheet with adjustable weights and a sample dataset from the last 6 months of feature requests and infra tickets
SQL query(s) that compute Reach and historical latency/cost deltas per initiative cohort from BigQuery / usage dataset
A short decision guide (1 page) for PMs explaining thresholds: Quick-win / Invest / Defer / Requires-Resourcing
Stakeholder review completed (Eng reliability lead, Console PM, Head of Dedicated Sales) with feedback addressed
Telemetry plan: Console dashboards to show top-ranked items, projected token-cost delta, and expected SLO risk per release
tasks: Research: compile 12 representative initiatives across Hosted/Dedicated/Private and compute historical metrics
Design: draft scoring formula and strata modifiers; run sensitivity analysis for weight ranges
Prototype: build a public Google Sheet and populate with sample rows; add sliders for weights
Data: author SQL to compute reach (active customers affected), current token volume, and per-token cost by model/variant
Review: 2 design reviews with Eng Reliability and Sales Solutions; iterate on complexity penalty heuristics
Integrate: create a lightweight Console view mock (Figma) to surface top-ranked initiatives and per-regime impact
Rollout: publish decision guide and train PMs in the roadmap-planning offsite
notes: Scoring formula sketch: Score = R * I * C / E * DeploymentMultiplier
DeploymentMultiplier = mean(1 + cost_delta_pct * cost_weight, 1 + latency_risk_score * latency_weight, 1 + rollout_complexity * complexity_weight)
We want multipliers >1 to increase priority when feature reduces cost/latency and <1 when it increases risk/cost
Latency risk score is derived from expected P50/P95 regression probability given changes to kernel scheduling, batching, or KV cache; use 0..1 scale
Rollout complexity factors: number of infra teams, customer migration steps, required data migrations, KMS/HSM dependencies

Example: A KV cache improvement affecting Hosted only may have high reach and impact but low complexity; a Dedicated autoscaler overhaul may have lower reach but high deployment complexity and revenue impact
Avoid double-counting: if initiative is both cost-reduction and reliability-improvement, capture both but cap combined multiplier to 1.5 by default to keep scores stable
risks: Overfitting weights to historical dataset — will mitigate with sensitivity analysis and holdout scenarios
Data quality: inaccurate reach or cost figures could skew decisions; require data owner signoff on source queries
Cross-team alignment: Sales and Enterprise success may push high-revenue private deployment asks; need bias guardrails
Complexity penalty may unintentionally deprioritize high-value long-term platform work — include an explicit long-term-investment exemption category
decision_thresholds: Score >= 8: Recommend ‘Invest’ with a resourcing plan and canary rollout
Score 4..7.9: ‘Consider’ for next-cycle small experiments or scoped spikes
Score 2..3.9: ‘Defer’ unless sponsor escalates with business case
implementation_plan: Week 1-2: Research & design; finalize formula and implement prototype sheet
Week 3: Data ingestion and SQL queries; produce top-12 example rankings
Week 4: Stakeholder reviews and weight calibration workshop
Week 5-6: Build Console mock and publish PM decision guide; plan training at roadmap offsite
Post-release: Run retrospective after first cycle and adjust weights based on realized cost/latency deltas
metrics_to_track: Top-10 prioritized initiatives and their predicted vs actual token-cost delta (monthly)
SLO regressions attributable to deployed initiatives (P95 latency increases)
% of roadmap items that required re-scoring after new deployment constraints
Time-to-approve for Invest items (days between proposal and resourcing decision)
